messages:
maya: heads up — our nightly indexing backfill started throwing a bunch of errors around 00:10 UTC. hitting vector DB rejects with a dim mismatch. sample error: 

vector-db: ERROR insert failed for doc id=acct_231/obj_9987: dimension mismatch (expected 1024, got 1536)

maya: backfill job id: bf-2026-03-15-02, worker node=idx-worker-07, affected ~12k docs so far.

ashley: ouch. did something change in the embeddings model or the index schema?

maya: that's the suspicion. our ingestion pipeline calls /v1/embeddings with model param `embed-large-v2` — but logs show some requests annotated with `embed-xl-2026` after last night's deploy. not sure if deploy rolled to prod.

deploy-bot: notice: rollout complete for embed-models/2026-03-14 at 23:42 UTC — variant `embed-xl-2026` enabled in canary and auto-rolled to 80% traffic.

jordan: embed-xl-2026 uses 1536 dims (we bumped to get more coverage). previous default was 1024. the vector DB schema stayed at 1024, so inserts are failing.

samir: can we short-term route indexer to the old model? what's the endpoint param?

ashley: yes — update the model param to `embed-large-v2` (1024) in the indexer config and restart workers. that should stop new rejects while we decide on schema migration.

maya: trying that now — updating k8s config map and rolling idx-worker deployment. will also pause the backfill jobs after the rollout finishes.

ops-bot: k8s: rolling update started for deployment idx-worker (3 replicas) by ashley at 2026-03-15T00:16:40Z

maya: rollback applied and restarted. re-running single doc test against vector DB...

maya: test insert success. now I'll drain the queue then reschedule backfill once we have a plan. current rejects ~12.3k docs.

jordan: long-term options: 1) migrate vector DB schema to 1536 and re-ingest all docs, 2) pin all production calls to 1024 model, 3) run dimensionality-reduction (PCA) during backfill to project 1536->1024. each has tradeoffs (storage, quality).

samir: do we have an infra-safe migration plan? re-ingesting 1.2M vectors is nontrivial. we also have rate limits and bill spikes to consider.

jordan: initial plan proposal (high level):
```
- freeze model rollout for customer-facing services
- schedule maintenance window for index migration
- create new index with 1536 dim mapping
- run backfill workers that re-embed docs (or transform existing vectors) into new index in batches
- validate recall/latency on canary subset
- switch alias to new index
- decommission old index
```

ashley: couple of immediate mitigations: add a pre-insert validation step in the indexer to drop/log bad-dim payloads, and surface a metric (vector_insert_dim_mismatch) to Sentry/Datadog so we can alert earlier.

maya: adding validation now. patch snippet: 
```python
# validate embedding length
if len(embedding) != expected_dim:
    metrics.counter("vector_insert_dim_mismatch").inc()
    log.warn(f"dim mismatch doc={doc_id} expected={expected_dim} got={len(embedding)}")
    continue
```

samir: also check auth/billing side — if a deploy caused more expensive model to serve, cost could spike and trigger quota/billing throttles for customers. anyone see billing alerts?

ops-bot: billing: usage anomaly detected for embeddings at 2026-03-15T00:05Z — 3.8x baseline for ~30m.

maya: yes saw that. I paused the backfill to avoid further charge. queued ~45k docs left.

ashley: action items:
- pause backfill (maya) — done
- add validation and metric (maya) — in progress
- pin indexer to 1024 model until migration approved (ashley) — done
- draft migration plan + cost estimate (jordan) — assigned
- notify customers on any possible downtime for search while we reindex (samir) — assigned

jordan: I'll draft migration steps and a staging run to estimate time + cost. quick note: if we do transform-existing-vectors (PCA) we can avoid re-embedding but quality may drop — will run eval on 10k sample.

maya: logging summary to the thread:
- root cause: unintended model rollout (embed-xl-2026, 1536 dims) during deploy at 23:42 UTC
- symptom: vector DB rejects inserts with dim mismatch (~12k immediate rejects, paused backfill prevented more)
- immediate fix: pinned indexer to 1024 model and paused backfill; added validation code to drop and log mismatched dims
- next: migration plan + cost/estimate from eng-ml, customer comms from support, schedule maintenance if needed

samir: thanks — please post the migration doc here when ready. I'll coordinate customer emails if we need an outage window. :thumbsup:

maya: will do. reassigning thread to jordan to produce migration POC.

jordan: copying notes into a ticket and will post updates. starting with a 10k-sample PCA vs re-embed eval tomorrow morning.

maya: closing the immediate incident — reopen if more rejects show up.

ops-bot: incident closed for bf-2026-03-15-02 at 2026-03-15T00:28:30Z (resolved: backfill paused, indexer pinned).
